correctness.rationale: The matrix proof is complete for all stated parameters. The consecutive-window matrix W has full column rank ell-k, so D=WW^T has nullity k and exactly the within-leg path-power support. The cross-leg matrix C has support a+b<=k, and the center vector has support a<=k, so the assembled block matrix has exactly the spider-power off-diagonal pattern. Vectors with leg components in ker(D) summing to zero form a kernel subspace of dimension (m-1)k. Therefore M>=(m-1)k; the standard M<=Z inequality and published Proposition 9 give the reverse chain. Exact-arithmetic and direct zero-forcing checks corroborate the construction on finite profiles but are not used as the infinite proof.
